1: 1. O Messenger! Indeed, I have granted you abundant goodness, from which is the river of Kawthar in Paradise.
2: 2. So be grateful to Allah for this blessing, by performing prayer for Him alone and offering sacrifice for Him, as opposed to the offerings of sacrifice the idolaters do for their idols.
3: 3. Indeed, your hater is cut off from every goodness, and will be forgotten. If remembered, he will be remembered negatively.
